scope: Latest user batch, twelve supplied screenshots, room/unit regression, online-booking discovery and shared loading behavior

screenshots.resolution: Public editorial and world images no longer render production-process labels over the media.

screenshots.finding: Spa hero carried the same redundant illustration badge
screenshots.resolution: Spa topic media is a clean responsive image with fixed intrinsic geometry and no overlay label.

screenshots.finding: Spa offer rail printed a repetitive booking disclaimer below the cards
screenshots.resolution: The repeated paragraph was removed from the rail; practical confirmation belongs in the booking/detail flow.

screenshots.finding: Guide card had a production label between image and title
screenshots.resolution: Guide cards retain category, reading time and title without the extra production label.

screenshots.finding: Guide hero placed a long illustration caption under the image
screenshots.resolution: Illustration captions are no longer printed below editorial hero media; intrinsic 1200x800 geometry remains.

screenshots.finding: Related guide cards mixed caption text into card content and cropped the visual hierarchy
screenshots.resolution: Related cards use a clean image-category-title-time hierarchy and a stable 3:2 mobile image ratio.

screenshots.finding: Magazine category rail began outside the rounded shell
screenshots.resolution: Desktop categories wrap inside the shell; mobile categories scroll inside the shell with bounded inline padding.

screenshots.finding: Duplicate view of the same magazine edge clipping
screenshots.resolution: Covered by the shared magazine-category layout fix, not a screenshot-specific offset.

screenshots.finding: Event availability area included redundant explanatory copy and previously duplicated controls
screenshots.resolution: The event block exposes only the three date tabs and the matching result state; cache implementation copy is absent.

screenshots.finding: Rated-event rail showed a clipped extra card and native horizontal scrollbar
screenshots.resolution: The shared event rail uses four complete desktop cards, responsive three/one-card sizing and hidden native scrollbars.

screenshots.finding: Duplicate view of the same event-rail clipping
screenshots.resolution: Covered by the shared event-rail geometry and scroll behavior.

screenshots.finding: Mobile event-region section had an excessive blank band before the heading
screenshots.resolution: Mobile section spacing is bounded and region cards keep a stable minimum height.

additionalSharedFixes.finding: Vacation room cards had a small image and a large empty white body
additionalSharedFixes.resolution: Room cards now use a 43 percent stable media column, 960x640 intrinsic media, compact facts and a mobile 16:10 media ratio without crowding the booking action.

additionalSharedFixes.finding: Facility lists looked generic and lost the earlier icon treatment
additionalSharedFixes.resolution: Desktop, mobile and modal vacation facility lists now reuse the semantic amenity icon system.

additionalSharedFixes.finding: Map payload rebuilt with full galleries
additionalSharedFixes.resolution: Map result cards receive one primary image only; static image preview remains until the user opens the map.

additionalSharedFixes.finding: Undated online-booking filter depended on a supplier request and could return no results
additionalSharedFixes.resolution: The public path is read-only against a persisted capability snapshot, refreshed weekly with fourteen-day last-good retention. Dated searches remain live.

additionalSharedFixes.finding: Repeated refreshes and implementation notes made result areas feel heavy
additionalSharedFixes.resolution: Client polling and public cache notes were removed; last good cards remain visible during refresh.
